label: AbiP2 system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses a single-component AbiP2-family reverse-transcriptase-like locus represented by DefenseFinder as a mandatory AbiP2__AbiP2 profile.
observations: AbiP2 branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual AbiP2__AbiP2 profiles, Abi-P2 proteins, P2 orf570 genes, generic reverse transcriptases, UG/Abi system parents, AbiK-family systems, lactococcal AbiP systems, DRT or retron loci, source database rows naming one AbiP2 model, and other abortive-infection systems.
